scope.mode: local-aligned; committed, staged and working tree

intent: Implement Phase 3 shared investigation ontology with source-grounded manual/provider proposals, human review and correction, cross-case identity repair, source independence and atomic append-only v1/v2 replay. Preserve existing security and evidence controls.

findings.suggested_fix: Extract the authorized event-snapshot filtering used by KnowledgeService.read(actor), including its final revision check, and require it for /api/ontology/workspace before invoking the pure compatibility DTO builder. Preserve the honest legacy whole-document citation adapter, but authorize its evidence too. Add HTTP regressions that accept v2 knowledge, redact/quarantine its source, and verify both ontology endpoints omit its values and dependent entity/relationship labels.
findings.title: [CWE-200] Legacy ontology route exposes revoked source values
findings.why_it_matters: After evidence becomes inaccessible through redaction, quarantine or credential-risk governance, its Phase 3 names and assertion values remain readable through the existing /api/ontology/workspace endpoint. The new compatibility adapter includes v2 proposals from an unfiltered ledger, while /api/ontology/knowledge correctly performs current citation authorization; the collapsed Legacy provenance UI also calls the bypassing endpoint. Applying the same current-authority filtering before either HTTP projection prevents the second route from disclosing content that the primary route hides, without rewriting history.

findings.suggested_fix: Require an explicitly supplied numeric unit to occur in the supporting quotation along with the matching numeric value, matching groundedValue in document-processing.ts. Prefer a shared pure grounding helper so provider and domain checks cannot diverge. Add manual-proposal and edit/accept regressions for correct, missing and mismatched units, including occurrence attributes.
findings.title: [CWE-20] Validate numeric units in manual knowledge decisions
findings.why_it_matters: The normal manual amount form can accept 120 EUR against a source saying only 'Acme paid 120 USD.' because domain grounding compares the numeric component and ignores the unit. Provider extraction checks the unit, so editing a provider proposal through manual controls weakens the promised shared validation boundary and permits an unsupported typed value into accepted knowledge. Validate the complete numeric value at the domain command boundary for both facts and occurrence attributes.

findings.suggested_fix: Resolve entity values through the current mention binding and its entity ID, passing bindings into the helper or exposing a current mention-to-entity map. Preserve original proposal labels only in explicitly historical views. Add a test that supersedes an entity label and checks current relationship and participant rendering.
findings.title: Resolve corrected entity labels through current bindings
findings.why_it_matters: After correcting an entity name through edit-as-new and supersession, current relationship and occurrence participant labels still show the old name. The helper selects the earliest proposal with that mention ID, but its superseded assertion no longer belongs to the current entity, so it falls back to the old proposal value. An in-memory normal command sequence reproduced canonicalLabel='Acme Incorporated' with displayedEndpoint='Acme'.

Use one shared membership predicate for row visibility and displayed case labels. findings.title: Include all bound knowledge for explicit entity memberships
findings.why_it_matters: Adding an existing entity to an otherwise empty investigation exposes its dossier button but hides its own entity mention, incoming relationships, and occurrence participation. The case filter follows explicit entity memberships only through subjectEntityId. The later dossier filter cannot recover rows already removed by this case filter, so normal cross-case entity reuse produces incomplete case views.

triage_groups.preferred_resolution: Fix current evidence authorization on the compatibility route first, then share numeric unit grounding.
triage_groups.why: Every entry point must preserve the same evidence boundary.

triage_groups.title: Current identity views
triage_groups.context: Current entity bindings are not used consistently when resolving labels and case memberships.
triage_groups.preferred_resolution: Resolve labels through current bindings and include member entities current assertion IDs in case filters.
triage_groups.why: Corrections and explicit cross-case membership must remain visible.

slices.evidence: Version-aware decoding and both atomic ledger implementations; retry/interruption tests present.
Shared cases/projection/schema/identity/lineage implemented; current identity rendering and membership findings remain.
Human commands, freshness and atomic group/correction validation implemented; numeric unit grounding and compatibility read authority findings remain.
Real transport/schema-aware extraction path implemented; caller separately identified 40-proposal extraction versus 24-proposal import limit mismatch.
Normal controls implemented, with current-label and entity-case filtering fixes required.
Caller owns final built-browser acceptance, verify, runbook/evidence and commits. Real/live validation remains explicitly pending authorized inputs.

residual_risks: Occurrence DTO convenience participant/time fields select the last accepted claim, but all per-proposal qualifiers and evidence remain in the DTO and UI; validator rejected loss-of-conflict finding #4. Consumers should continue reading proposal claims for competing qualifiers.
Legacy v1 shared dossier source lists require integration coverage; the compatibility view retains whole-document citation scope.
Real-record and live-provider acceptance have not been established. Synthetic/local-provider evidence must remain labeled.
Repeated provider runs yield separate occurrence proposal identities. Current UI marks cross-source identity unresolved and offers explicit identity reuse; no independent event total is claimed.
testing_gaps: Entity label supersession rendering is not covered by the shared UI tests.
Explicit entity-only case memberships need browser/component coverage for incoming relationships and occurrence participants.
Multiple accepted source claims using one occurrence ID need conflict and partial-qualifier projection coverage.
Current denied-knowledge tests exercise KnowledgeService.read(actor), but do not check the legacy ontology HTTP endpoint after evidence revocation.
Numeric unit grounding lacks parity coverage between the manual domain commands and provider extraction path.

verdicts.reason: The legacy handler passes the unfiltered ledger to a DTO builder that emits v2 proposal values, whereas the authenticated knowledge route revalidates citation and evidence access before projecting them.

Manual proposals use validateEvidence and hasValue, whose numeric branch compares only the parsed number even when the accepted value carries a unit, so a quoted USD amount can support an accepted EUR value.
displayValue selects the first proposal for a mention while current entities retain the replacement assertion ID, causing a superseded entity proposal to fall back to its stale string label.

Although the aggregate occurrence map overwrites its convenience fields, the same DTO retains every accepted proposal with its own participants and times, and the UI renders those per-proposal values rather than the aggregate qualifiers.

A direct entity membership makes the entity selectable but caseProposals admits only knowledge/evidence memberships or subjectEntityId, so the entity's own assertion plus incoming relationships and participant occurrences are removed before dossier filtering.
